elements_selected.content: Add all new types needed for SPEC-006 to src/types.rs. Implement: 1) type ContentHash = [u8; 32], 2) enum LeafType { Heading { level: u8 }, Paragraph, CodeBlock { language: Option<String> }, SplBlock, List { ordered: bool }, BlockQuote, Table, Frontmatter, ThematicBreak, HtmlBlock }, 3) struct SplLeafHash { content_hash: ContentHash, ast_hash: ContentHash }, 4) struct MerkleLeaf { node_type: LeafType, start_line: u32, end_line: u32, hash: ContentHash, spl_hashes: Option<SplLeafHash> }, 5) struct Section { heading_line: u32, heading_text: String, heading_level: u8, leaf_range: (usize, usize), grounding_hash: ContentHash }, 6) struct FileMerkle { root_hash: ContentHash, sections: Vec<Section>, spl_leaves: Vec<SplLeafCached> }, 7) struct SplLeafCached { start_line: u32, content_hash: ContentHash, ast_hash: ContentHash, section_index: usize, explicit_groundings: Vec<ExplicitGrounding> }, 8) struct ExplicitGrounding { construct: String, source_refs: Vec<String>, targets: Vec<ResolvedTarget> }, 9) struct ResolvedTarget { source_ref: String, target_file: PathBuf, target_leaf_hash: ContentHash }, 10) struct DriftDiagnostic { file: PathBuf, spl_line: u32, drift_type: DriftType, severity: DriftSeverity, message: String }, 11) enum DriftType { SectionDrift { section_heading: String }, ExplicitDrift { construct: String, source_ref: String } }, 12) enum DriftSeverity { Info, Warning }. All types derive Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone where appropriate. ContentHash serializes as hex string.
